notes: Ludum Dare 58 game by Bruno Cicanci / cicanci (https://github.com/cicanci/game-unity-ld58), theme Collector. Complete Unity 6000.2.6f2 project with playable scene Assets/Scenes/PlaygroundScene.unity enabled in EditorBuildSettings. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2025 Bruno Cicanci). Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json (all registry or builtin from packages.unity.com): URP 17.2.0, Input System 1.14.2, AI Navigation 2.0.9, Timeline 1.8.9, uGUI 2.0.0, test framework, Visual Studio IDE package, and built-in modules. LiberationSans (SIL Open Font License 1.1) is the bundled TextMesh Pro default font; LiberationSans - OFL.txt is retained. TextMesh Pro EmojiOne sprites/asset were omitted; TMP Settings.asset m_defaultSpriteAsset was cleared and m_enableEmojiSupport was set to 0 because they pointed at the omitted EmojiOne asset; the playable scene does not require it. No TMP Documentation or Examples & Extras were present. No DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no Library/Logs/LFS/DLL, no .DS_Store. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. ~4.8M src snapshot.
